name: tracebrief
description: Evidence-first reverse-engineering reports built on REA Evidence bundles

scripts.render:sample: node bin/tracebrief.mjs render --report fixtures/report.clipnote.json --bundle fixtures/clipnote-bundle.json --out reports/clipnote-search.md
scripts.render:sample:managed: node bin/tracebrief.mjs render --report fixtures/report.system-data.json --bundle fixtures/system-data-bundle.json --out reports/system-data-managed.md
scripts.render:sample:unknowns: node bin/tracebrief.mjs render --report fixtures/report.clipnote-unknowns.json --bundle fixtures/clipnote-unknowns-bundle.json --out reports/clipnote-residual-unknowns.md
